{{One source|date=September 2024}}
In [[mathematical analysis]], a '''Ditkin set''', introduced by {{harvs|last=Ditkin|year=1939|authorlink=Vitalii Ditkin}}, is a closed subset of the [[circle]] such that a [[Function (mathematics)|function]] ''f'' vanishing on the [[Set (mathematics)|set]] can be approximated by functions φ<sub>''n''</sub>''f'' with φ vanishing in a neighborhood of the set.
